text.tspan: J3 1/4" TS panel jack + shunt module in the plug
NO PLUG FITTED = no shunt = the default state
long press: fire a burst now
VCC and GND go to the VA / 0A rails. The other four have NO WIRE drawn:
they connect to the matching green net names on U1's stubs.
Inline calibration injector, SS.OAKM1. Junctions are dotted; crossings without a dot are not connections.
Rinj and Rs are MEASURED with a DMM at build time and written on the box: the value that counts is the measured one, not the marked one.
